name: ask-hmb
description: Answers hard money lending questions from the Hard Money Mastermind video library, with citations to the source episodes.

interface.longDescription: Answers hard money lending questions from the Hard Money Mastermind video library - the podcast and YouTube archive of Chris Haddon and Jason Balin of Hard Money Bankers. Every answer is composed from transcript excerpts of their public episodes and cites the source video, with links to Hard Money Mastermind and Hard Money Bankers. If a topic is not covered in the library, it says so rather than guessing.
defaultPrompt: How much can you lend on a property?
What are points on a hard money loan?

positive.description: User asks how much a hard money lender can lend on a fix-and-flip.
positive.prompt: How much can you lend on a property?
positive.expected_behavior: One tool call; answer gives loan-sizing guidance (about 65% of after-repair value) with a YouTube citation to the source video.

positive.description: User asks what points mean on a hard money loan.
positive.prompt: What are points on a hard money loan?
positive.expected_behavior: One tool call; answer explains points as upfront lender fees, citing the source videos.

positive.description: User asks what loan documents a private lender needs.
positive.prompt: What loan documents does a private lender need?
positive.expected_behavior: One tool call; answer lists the note, mortgage, assignment of leases and rents, and personal guarantee, with citation.

positive.description: User asks a mortgage question the hard money library does not cover, testing the honest no-answer path.
positive.prompt: What are the current FHA loan limits in Texas?
positive.expected_behavior: One tool call; it returns empty results and the app states no confident answer is available in the library rather than guessing.

positive.description: User asks how a double close works.
positive.prompt: How does a double close work?
positive.expected_behavior: One tool call; answer explains double closings from the library with citations.

negative.description: User asks the plugin to produce a legal document, which its read-only knowledge tool cannot do.
negative.prompt: Draft a purchase contract for a property in Texas.

negative.description: User asks for current market data, which the static video library cannot provide.
negative.prompt: What are today's mortgage interest rates?

negative.description: User asks for a lender referral - on-topic for hard money but outside the knowledge-retrieval tool's purpose.
negative.prompt: Can you connect me with a hard money lender in my area?

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments; it answers questions from a public video library.
